Use this recipe for ai generation: Game Scene Journey
Duration: 30 seconds

[seedance] must generate exactly three video segments: Segment One (10s), Segment Two (10s), Segment Three (10s); generating any reference images is strictly prohibited.

The base video generated by [seedance] must not include any game UI, health bars, mini-maps, quest frames, subtitle boxes, scene name text, watermarks, or play buttons; only pure in-game 3D visuals (characters + environment + motion + lip-sync audio) are allowed.

BGM: After [code2video] rendering completes, SUNO V5 will independently generate a seamless background music track—light and cheerful, suitable for travel-themed instrumental music at -30dB. [seedance] must not generate BGM.

Sound Effects: [seedance] must generate ambient sound effects (footsteps, crowd noise, flowing water, mounts, etc.) only at corresponding action points, at -20dB. No TTS robotic narration is allowed.

Strict Execution Steps (must follow sequentially; parallel processing is forbidden)

Step 1: Art Style Anchoring  
[seedance] must first analyze the overall art style of the game screenshot reference [] (rendering technique, outlines, color saturation, materials, lighting, character proportions, and scene integration). This style must be locked as the global Identity Anchor.  
All subsequent video segments, characters, scenes, and props must strictly adhere to this art style. Style changes mid-sequence, realistic abrupt shifts, or plastic-looking AI-generated faces are prohibited.

Step 2: [seedance 2.0] Generate Three Base Videos (each 10s, 720p)

General Constraints  
1. Art Style: Must remain consistent with the analysis results from the game screenshot reference [].  
2. Subject: The main character [] must maintain consistent identity, clothing, and facial features across all three segments.  
3. Scene: Each segment must use the corresponding "scene reference image/video[]" as spatial and set design basis, ensuring consistency in architecture, props, and lighting logic.  
4. Storyline: Must faithfully depict the corresponding "storyline[]". Interactions, actions, and emotions between characters must be automatically completed by [seedance] in accordance with the art style, ensuring natural and fluid motion. Penetration, teleportation, or joint deformation is strictly prohibited.  

5. Dialogue: If the storyline[] includes character dialogue, [seedance] must automatically generate both dialogue content and lip-sync animations. Dialogue language must be automatically detected based on the scene reference image/video[] and storyline[], using English unless otherwise specified (multiple languages should be assigned reasonably according to character roles). Lip movements must synchronize precisely with dialogue, with natural pacing.  

6. Camera: Primarily third-person gameplay-style tracking shots or over-the-shoulder perspectives, with slight handheld breathing effect allowed. Split-screen is prohibited. No UI elements may appear. Stuttering or discontinuity is strictly forbidden.  

7. Prohibited Elements: CG-like plastic skin textures, oily highlight faces, extra fingers, text burned into the frame, watermarks, subtitle bars, or quest panels.

Segment One (00:00 - 00:10) | Scene One  
Narrative:  
In the environment shown in the scene one reference image/video[], the main character[] enters and unfolds the events described in the scene one storyline[]. Opening: Establish the environment and character relationships.  
Middle: Deliver the core interaction, conflict, or comedic moment.  
End: Leave a lingering action that seamlessly transitions into the next segment. If dialogue is included, characters speak in real time, with language automatically recognized based on the scene.

Shot:  
[0-2s] Setup shot: Present the spatial layout of Scene 1; main character(s) enter or are already present, movements restrained, allowing visual breathing room for the scene title (no text at this layer).  
[2-10s] Main narrative: Fully unfold the story of Scene 1; synchronize lip movements if dialogue occurs; camera movement automatically selected by seedance (following, over-the-shoulder, slight push), maintaining cinematic continuity typical of game cutscenes.

Segment Two (00:10 - 00:20) | Scene Two  
Narrative:  
Seamlessly transition to the reference image/video of Scene Two's environment; main character(s) [may be accompanied by companions, if story requires] begin unfolding the plot of Scene Two. Maintain consistent pacing as in Segment One: setup → development → resolution. Dialogue language automatically recognized based on Scene Two.

Shot:  
[10-12s] Setup shot: Reveal the spatial setting of Scene Two; clearly position main character(s).  
[12-20s] Main narrative: Unfold the story of Scene Two; synchronize lip movements during dialogue; prohibit stylistic drift.

Segment Three (00:20 - 00:30) | Scene Three  
Narrative:  
Transition to the reference image/video of Scene Three's environment; main character(s) advance the plot of Scene Three, forming either the climax or a humorous conclusion to the 30-second journey. Dialogue language automatically recognized based on Scene Three.

Shot:  
[20-22s] Setup shot: Reveal the spatial setting of Scene Three.  
[22-30s] Main narrative: Unfold the story of Scene Three; synchronize lip movements during dialogue; actions may have slightly stronger impact than the first two segments, yet remain within the same visual style.

Step Three: [code2video] Top-level rendering (executed after merging the three base-layer videos) General Provisions
1. First, analyze the reference game screenshot [], extract all UI elements in the scene (including but not limited to: health hearts/health bars, stamina rings, quick-item icons, ability icons, mini-map, time/weather/temperature indicators, quest tracking boxes, dialogue box styles, key prompts, discovered location markers, etc.), recreate their shapes, outlines, transparency, and relative layouts, and export them as transparent layer assets.

2. Use medeo to reverse-engineer the video generated by [seedance], precisely identifying dialogue timestamps to two decimal places. Then organize the script and timeline [code2video] based on the dialogue and timing data extracted by medeo for rendering.

3. Overlay the UI onto the three 10-second video clips; the UI must not obscure the main character’s face or core action areas [].

4. Strictly prohibit burning the UI into the base layer of [seedance]; all UI must be transparently composited via [code2video]. The original audio from [seedance] must be preserved during rendering.

A. Global Game HUD (present throughout all three clips, styled after the reference game screenshot [])
- Top-left: Health/status bar and quick-access bar icons
- Bottom-right: Circular mini-map + time/weather/temperature indicators
- Other elements such as ability bars, quest bars, etc., should only be included if present in the reference image—do not forcibly add missing ones
- Prohibit any watermarks from platforms like Xiaohongshu; if the reference image contains watermarks, remove them during rendering

B. Scene Name Bar (fixed 2 seconds at the beginning of each clip)
Style aligned with the reference video "Discovery: Location Name" or in-game location name bars: semi-transparent background + main title + optional subtitle, positioned bottom-left or at the same position as shown in the reference game screenshot []
- Clip 1: 00:00–00:02 display Scene One Name []
- Clip 2: 00:10–00:12 display Scene Two Name []
- Clip 3: 00:20–00:22 display Scene Three Name []—fade out after 2 seconds; do not reappear within the same clip

C. Dialogue Subtitles / Dialogue Box Rendering
When a character speaks in a [seedance] clip, [code2video] must first render the dialogue using the exact dialogue box style from the reference game screenshot []:
- Semi-transparent dialogue background box + white text + optional speaker label + optional Ⓐ/key prompt
- Position: Centered slightly lower on the screen (approx. Y:78%-90%), avoiding obstruction of the mini-map
- Display only one line at a time, synchronized with lip-sync timing; strictly prohibit displaying entire paragraphs at once
- Language must match the original audio from [seedance]
- No dialogue box should appear in clips without dialogue

[code2video] Compositing Steps
1. Import the base videos for Clip 1, 2, and 3, and concatenate them in order: 0–10 / 10–20 / 20–30
2. Overlay the global HUD (extracted from the reference game screenshot [])
3. Add the corresponding scene name [] overlay for 2 seconds at the start of each clip
4. Composite dialogue layers according to medeo/lip-sync timing (or manually aligned)
5. After [code2video] completes rendering, SUNO V5 will generate a continuous BGM track separately

Quality Constraints
- All three clips must maintain consistent visual style matching the reference game screenshot []; characters must retain the same appearance and outfit across segments
- Scene architecture and key landmarks must be recognizable from the reference images/videos []; cross-scene mixing is prohibited
- Lip-sync, original audio, and subtitles must be perfectly synchronized
- Prohibit frame drops, freezes, limb clipping, or text jitter

Negative Prompts Plastic face, oily skin, real-to-animated mutation, sudden art style shifts, UI burned into the background layer, watermarks, misspelled subtitles, English scenes forced to use English (unless the storyline explicitly requires otherwise), extra fingers, horses/vehicles sliding or floating, scene names remaining on screen for more than 2 seconds

{"screenplay": "# Game Scene Journey: A Parisian Adventure

## Creative Brief

**Concept:** A cel-shaded fantasy RPG heroine embarks on a whimsical 30-second journey through Paris — visiting the Eiffel Tower, the Seine riverbank, and the Arc de Triomphe. Each scene blends the fantasy adventurer aesthetic with real Parisian landmarks rendered in the game's warm, stylized cel-shaded art style.

**Tone:** Whimsical, cheerful, adventurous — the lightness of a travel RPG side-quest.

**Art Style:** Cel-shaded illustration with warm color palette, soft outlines, painterly lighting. Consistent with the provided game screenshot reference.

**Duration:** 30 seconds total (3 × 10s segments)

**Format:** 16:9, 720p

---

## Characters

**Main Character:** A determined young female fantasy adventurer — braided hair, medieval tunic, leather traveling gear, belt, crossbody satchel, and boots. Resolute expression with a warm adventurous spirit.

---

## Screenplay

### Scene 1 — Eiffel Tower (00:00–00:10)
**Scene Name:** "Eiffel Tower Plaza"

The adventurer arrives at the Eiffel Tower on a bright sunny day, crossing the Seine bridge. She looks up in wonder at the towering landmark. Foreign tourists notice her unusual attire and approach with curiosity. She laughs and poses for a photo with them, holding up a peace sign, her satchel swinging.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (cheerfully): *"You've got quite the view here! Mind if I join your quest log?"*
Tourist replies (warmly): *"Of course! Smile!"*

### Scene 2 — Seine Riverbank (00:10–00:20)
**Scene Name:** "Seine Riverside"

The adventurer settles at the Seine embankment, the Orsay Museum glowing softly across the water. She sets up a small easel, opens her satchel, and pulls out paint and brushes. A café cup steams beside her. She paints the river scene, humming quietly, occasionally sipping coffee. A nearby couple smiles at her canvas.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (contentedly): *"This light… it's like the world itself is casting a golden-hour buff."*

### Scene 3 — Arc de Triomphe (00:20–00:30)
**Scene Name:** "Arc de Triomphe"

The adventurer arrives at the grand Arc de Triomphe plaza. A circle of street performers — musicians, dancers — has drawn a crowd. The adventurer claps along, then is pulled into the circle by a laughing performer. She dances with strangers, arms wide, spinning joyfully under the blue sky. The crowd cheers.

**Dialogue:** Street Performer says (enthusiastically): *"Come on, adventurer! Everyone dances at the Triomphe!"*
Adventurer replies (laughing): *"Ha! An experience quest — I never say no!"*

---

# Game Scene Journey: A Parisian Adventure

## Creative Brief

**Concept:** A cel-shaded fantasy RPG heroine embarks on a whimsical 30-second journey through Paris — visiting the Eiffel Tower, the Seine riverbank, and the Arc de Triomphe. Each scene blends the fantasy adventurer aesthetic with real Parisian landmarks rendered in the game's warm, stylized cel-shaded art style.

**Tone:** Whimsical, cheerful, adventurous — the lightness of a travel RPG side-quest.

**Art Style:** Cel-shaded illustration with warm color palette, soft outlines, painterly lighting. Consistent with the provided game screenshot reference.

**Duration:** 30 seconds total (3 × 10s segments)

**Format:** 16:9, 720p

---

## Characters

**Main Character:** A determined young female fantasy adventurer — braided hair, medieval tunic, leather traveling gear, belt, crossbody satchel, and boots. Resolute expression with a warm adventurous spirit.

---

## Screenplay

### Scene 1 — Eiffel Tower (00:00–00:10)
**Scene Name:** "Eiffel Tower Plaza"

The adventurer arrives at the Eiffel Tower on a bright sunny day, crossing the Seine bridge. She looks up in wonder at the towering landmark. Foreign tourists notice her unusual attire and approach with curiosity. She laughs and poses for a photo with them, holding up a peace sign, her satchel swinging.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (cheerfully): *"You've got quite the view here! Mind if I join your quest log?"*
Tourist replies (warmly): *"Of course! Smile!"*

### Scene 2 — Seine Riverbank (00:10–00:20)
**Scene Name:** "Seine Riverside"

The adventurer settles at the Seine embankment, the Orsay Museum glowing softly across the water. She sets up a small easel, opens her satchel, and pulls out paint and brushes. A café cup steams beside her. She paints the river scene, humming quietly, occasionally sipping coffee. A nearby couple smiles at her canvas.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (contentedly): *"This light… it's like the world itself is casting a golden-hour buff."*

### Scene 3 — Arc de Triomphe (00:20–00:30)
**Scene Name:** "Arc de Triomphe"

The adventurer arrives at the grand Arc de Triomphe plaza. A circle of street performers — musicians, dancers — has drawn a crowd. The adventurer claps along, then is pulled into the circle by a laughing performer. She dances with strangers, arms wide, spinning joyfully under the blue sky. The crowd cheers.

**Dialogue:** Street Performer says (enthusiastically): *"Come on, adventurer! Everyone dances at the Triomphe!"*
Adventurer replies (laughing): *"Ha! An experience quest — I never say no!"*

# Game Scene Journey: A Parisian Adventure

## Creative Brief

**Concept:** A cel-shaded fantasy RPG heroine embarks on a whimsical 30-second journey through Paris — visiting the Eiffel Tower, the Seine riverbank, and the Arc de Triomphe. Each scene blends the fantasy adventurer aesthetic with real Parisian landmarks rendered in the game's warm, stylized cel-shaded art style.

**Tone:** Whimsical, cheerful, adventurous — the lightness of a travel RPG side-quest.

**Art Style:** Cel-shaded illustration with warm color palette, soft outlines, painterly lighting. Consistent with the provided game screenshot reference.

**Duration:** 30 seconds total (3 × 10s segments)

**Format:** 16:9, 720p

---

## Characters

**Main Character:** A determined young female fantasy adventurer — braided hair, medieval tunic, leather traveling gear, belt, crossbody satchel, and boots. Resolute expression with a warm adventurous spirit.

---

## Screenplay

### Scene 1 — Eiffel Tower (00:00–00:10)
**Scene Name:** "Eiffel Tower Plaza"

The adventurer arrives at the Eiffel Tower on a bright sunny day, crossing the Seine bridge. She looks up in wonder at the towering landmark. Foreign tourists notice her unusual attire and approach with curiosity. She laughs and poses for a photo with them, holding up a peace sign, her satchel swinging.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (cheerfully): *"You've got quite the view here! Mind if I join your quest log?"*
Tourist replies (warmly): *"Of course! Smile!"*

### Scene 2 — Seine Riverbank (00:10–00:20)
**Scene Name:** "Seine Riverside"

The adventurer settles at the Seine embankment, the Orsay Museum glowing softly across the water. She sets up a small easel, opens her satchel, and pulls out paint and brushes. A café cup steams beside her. She paints the river scene, humming quietly, occasionally sipping coffee. A nearby couple smiles at her canvas.

**Dialogue:** Adventurer says (contentedly): *"This light… it's like the world itself is casting a golden-hour buff."*
